input.quote: 21.1 Except for Excluded Claims, each Party's total aggregate liability arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall not exceed the greater of the Fees paid or payable by Customer during the twelve months preceding the event giving rise to the claim and USD 1,000,000. The cap is mutual and applies regardless of the form of action or number of claims.
input.rationale: Section 21 meets the preferred position in full. 21.1 sets a mutual aggregate cap at the greater of (a) Fees paid or payable by Customer in the twelve months preceding the triggering event and (b) USD 1,000,000; "Fees" (1.5) covers recurring subscription, professional services and usage fees, and with the USD 2,000,000 per year commitment in 2.1 the fee-based limb is meaningful rather than illusory. 21.2 provides a mutual exclusion of indirect/consequential damages and helpfully confirms data restoration, replacement services, notification and incident-response costs are direct damages. 21.3 defines "Excluded Claims" as uncapped for confidentiality, data-protection and security breaches, indemnification obligations, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud, and infringement of the other Party's IP, and confirms Customer's obligation to pay undisputed Fees is not "damages" subject to the cap. 21.4 preserves independence of each cap and survival beyond failure of an exclusive remedy. No competing or one-sided liability limit appears in the warranty, indemnity or insurance provisions (18.2 expressly states insurance does not limit Vendor's liabilities). No redline needed.
